1. Maintain a decreasing stack of unresolved elements for next-greater-element queries.
2. When 4 arrives, pop 1 and record next greater = 4; pop 2 and record the same.
3. Push 4. No later greater value exists in this input.
Each element is pushed and popped at most once, so total time is O(n).
